name: Disney's The Haunted Mansion
storyline: A young woman named Yazz searches the Mansion for her lost friends Cyrus and Rikki, encountering the various happy haunts within, while trying to also lift the curse on the Mansion and free Master Gracey before the clock strikes 13.
summary: A cancelled port of Disney's The Haunted Mansion for the Game Boy Advance. Though the game's release was cancelled, a casualty of publisher TDK being bought out by Take2, a mostly complete ROM prototype has since found its way online.
